release.milestone: Z12.1 — SQLite e núcleo de persistência

key_errors: bytesEqual in VM: wrong number of arguments. got=2, want=1
binary file round-trip loaded an incorrect builtin

root_cause.explanation: OpGetBuiltin truncated indexes above 255, causing the VM to load unrelated builtins. The evaluator resolves builtins by name and was unaffected.

fix.bytecode_public_compatibility: No public persisted bytecode format exists at this stage, so the internal operand-width change does not break a public artifact.

tests_added_or_updated: code.Make encodes builtin index 261 as bytes 0x01 0x05
code.ReadOperands reads a two-byte builtin operand
instruction disassembly preserves index 261 and subsequent offsets
VM executes bytesEqual above the uint8 boundary
existing binary I/O and evaluator/VM conformance tests pass

validation.sandbox_limitations: No network and Go 1.23.2 installed while the project requests Go 1.24.2.
validation.method: A temporary clone used Go 1.23.2 and compile-only local stubs for unavailable third-party integrations. No stubs are included in the release.
passed: go test ./... in the temporary validation clone
native SQLite Clang build and execution
native SQLite GCC build and execution

always_include: complete created/modified/removed inventory grouped by folder

handoff_summary_pt_br: Use o ZIP completo 0.5.1 como baseline somente após go test ./..., scripts/test-sqlite.sh e go run . version passarem no ambiente do usuário. A correção amplia OpGetBuiltin de uint8 para uint16 porque o Z12.1 elevou a tabela para 263 builtins e os índices 256-262 eram truncados na VM. Z12.1 continua sendo o marco atual; depois da validação, seguir para Z12.2 com savepoints, migrations, versionamento de schema e streaming incremental de rows.
